verdict.rationale: The only AI-driven route to insights from Mailgun data is the official MCP server, which lets an external AI assistant check delivery stats and troubleshoot DNS conversationally. That happens through a third-party assistant, not inside Mailgun itself, and the product's own analytics and tracking are not described as AI-generated. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions, any documentation of AI-generated recommendations from engagement or deliverability data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
